verdict.note: Accepted all three approval items: the observed-outcome definition only makes the existing complete-log consistency map explicit; the finite-sample common-component lower bound and randomized two-sign attainment are correct with eta_n approaching a_*^c and Delta_n approaching delta(1-a_*); and the metadata faithfully transfers only the converse, not attainment or positive calibration, to Li-Zhao's larger baseline class.
